site.name: Bailey Shaft
site.location: Red Mountain Mining District / Ironton quadrangle
overview: Bailey Shaft is a named inactive gold-and-silver mine feature in Ouray County's Red Mountain mining area, preserved in USGS-derived place and topographic records.
The mapped mine locality lies on the Ironton quadrangle at approximately 37.90944, -107.69562 and provides a stable location for identifying this historic shaft site.

timeline.text: Bailey Shaft formed part of the dense mine and shaft landscape around Red Mountain and Ironton in the San Juan Mountains.
USGS-derived topographic and place records retain Bailey Shaft Mine as a named inactive mine feature on the Ironton quadrangle.

moreHistory: USGS-derived place data identifies Bailey Shaft Mine in Ouray County as an inactive gold-and-silver mine at about 11,099 feet elevation.
The Ironton topographic map independently retains Bailey Shaft Mine among the named historic mining features in the surrounding Red Mountain landscape.
A focused exact-site media search did not locate a rights-cleared reusable photograph of Bailey Shaft; nearby Red Mountain and Ironton images were rejected rather than attached to the wrong site.
